author: Bobby Grayson
description:
README, the to_lean.exs row of the Layout table, replace with:
| `elixir/to_lean.exs` | The translator: `@type`-directed (`msg`, `cast`, `info`, `call`, `reply`, `state`), small subset, unverified; `handle_continue` is inlined, not sent; the pure fragment is compiled as a language, so any sub-expression may be an `if`, a `case`, a block or a binding (pipes, `cond` and `unless` are desugared away first) |

README, a new paragraph for the Readiness section (numbers are wf7/control alone, to be re-counted after the round is integrated):
Round 7 made the pure fragment a language rather than a body shape. An
expression may now be an `if`/`case`/`cond`, a block `(a; b; c)` (nested
`let`s) or a binding, `a |> f(b)` is rewritten to `f(a, b)` before anything
else looks at the module, and the Kernel type tests are decided statically
from the modelled type (`is_pid` on a `pid()` is `true`; an opaque `term()`
or a tagged union is an error, not a guess). A statement with an effect
before an `if`/`case` body is pushed into every branch instead of being
refused. Over the five real projects that took the blocker count from 1621
to 1421 and emptied eleven families outright, among them `if/case not at
body level` (98 occurrences in 28 modules), `pipe |>` (38) and `block as a
sub-expression` (26).

NOTES.md, a paragraph for the round-7 section:
The interesting constraint was totality. Lean's `let` has nothing to fall
through to, so a pattern binding is accepted only when the pattern is total
at its type -- a variable, `_`, a pair at a product type, a struct pattern
-- and `{:ok, v} = Map.fetch(m, k)` is a clear error telling you to match
instead. A `cond` must end in `true ->`, because falling off the end raises
CondClauseError and an expression in the model cannot raise. An `if` with
no `else` is nil, which the model has only at an Option type. The Kernel
type tests fall out of the same discipline from the other side: a value of
the model has exactly one type, so the test is a compile-time constant, and
where it is not (an opaque `Term`, a tagged union with both atom and tuple
alternatives, any binary) the translator says so rather than guessing.
